evidence_scope: Sufficient to reject the evaluated Joint Early-Fusion and Shared-Private implementations, but not to universally reject cross-technology shared forecasting because backbone, channel count, depth, parameterization, and training budget were not strictly matched to Independent ModernTCN.
matched_rerun_reason: Both evaluated joint implementations lost in all 12 technology-horizon combinations; further investment conflicts with the fastest-validation objective for the final paper route.
reason: All pre-specified Shared-Private screening conditions failed; do not develop a v2/v3 of this implementation route.
